# SpinCare Repairs

> Independent, multi-brand doorstep washing machine repair service in Mumbai, India, focused on Western Line stations (Churchgate to Virar), with coverage across key Central and Harbour Line areas.

Important: SpinCare Repairs is an independent repair service. It is NOT affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by Siemens, Samsung, Bosch, LG or any other brand, and is not an official service centre, customer care or helpline of any manufacturer. Brand names are used only to describe the machines it repairs.

## Services
- Front load washing machine repair (drum, bearing, door lock, motor, spin)
- Top load washing machine repair
- Semi-automatic washing machine repair
- Not draining / not spinning
- Drum noise and bearing replacement
- PCB and error code diagnosis
- Water leakage
- Installation and preventive service

## Brands repaired
Siemens, Bosch, LG, Samsung, IFB, Whirlpool, Godrej, Haier, Panasonic, Onida, Videocon, Voltas Beko

## How pricing works
- Any visit/inspection charge is told on the call before booking
- Written quote after diagnosis; work only after customer approval
- OEM or compatible parts as agreed; pay after repair (UPI/cash)
- Warranty on replaced parts (duration per part, printed on invoice); free revisit for the same fault within warranty

## Contact

- Hours: Mon–Sun, 8 AM – 9 PM
- Area: Mumbai (Western, Central & Harbour lines)
